description: A soft handheld brush of feathers used to flick dust from the exterior of a closed volume without abrading the covering. Its gentle action lifts surface grit while avoiding the friction that would mark delicate leather or cloth.
name: feather duster

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XXI, p.291. Internet Archive.
